paperTitleZh: 物理 全新模擬卷 — 卷二 選修 B 原子世界（結構題）

parts.label: a
parts.questionTextZh:
氫原子的能級可表示為 $E_n=-\dfrac{13.6}{n^2}\ \text{eV}$，其中 $n=1,2,3,\dots$。圖 2.2 顯示氫原子最低的幾個能級。
解釋為何氫氣放電管發出的光譜是線光譜。
parts.questionTextEn:
The energy levels of the hydrogen atom are given by $E_n=-\dfrac{13.6}{n^2}\ \text{eV}$, where $n=1,2,3,\dots$. Figure 2.2 shows the lowest few energy levels of the hydrogen atom.
Explain why the spectrum of light from a hydrogen discharge tube is a line spectrum.

parts.label: b(i)
parts.questionTextZh: 這些原子回到基態時，最多可發出多少種不同波長的光子？
parts.questionTextEn: What is the greatest number of different wavelengths of photons these atoms can emit on returning to the ground state?

parts.label: b(ii)
parts.questionTextZh: 在圖 2.2 上，以箭嘴畫出發出最長波長光子的躍遷，並解釋你的選擇。
parts.questionTextEn: On Figure 2.2, draw an arrow for the transition that emits the photon of the longest wavelength, and explain your choice.

parts.label: b(iii)
parts.questionTextZh: 求 (b)(ii) 中最長的波長，並指出這光子屬於電磁波譜的哪個區域。
parts.questionTextEn: Find the longest wavelength in (b)(ii), and state the region of the electromagnetic spectrum to which this photon belongs.

parts.label: b(iv)
parts.questionTextZh: 其中一個處於 $n=3$ 的原子吸收一個光子後被電離，釋放的電子動能為 $0.50\ \text{eV}$。求該光子的波長，並判斷相同波長的光子能否使處於基態的氫原子電離。
parts.questionTextEn: One of the atoms in the $n=3$ level absorbs a photon and is ionized, releasing an electron with kinetic energy $0.50\ \text{eV}$. Find the wavelength of the photon, and determine whether photons of the same wavelength can ionize hydrogen atoms in the ground state.
